question: The unit of Force is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kgms**____**-2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The unit of force in the International System of Units (SI) is the **Newton (N)**.
 
• 1 Newton is defined as the force required to accelerate a mass of 1 kilogram at a rate of **1 meter per second squared (1 m/s²).**
 
• **Force is defined **as an interaction that changes the state of rest or uniform motion of an object.
 
• Mathematically: Force (F)=mass (m)×acceleration (a), **So, 1 Newton = 1 kg·m/s²**.
